rows.en: It's heading straight for Earth from the direction where Planet Gyeron used to be!
Hawk 2, Hawk 2… This is the operations room, respond! Respond!
This is Hawk 2…

There's a flying object heading straight for Earth from the direction where Planet Gyeron used to be!

Investigate it!
Roger! Investigating.
I wonder what it is? This flying object…
Ah!! Furuhashi, look!
Th-there it is!
Hawk 2 to operations room… Hawk 2 to operations room!!
Operations room here!
We've found it!
Is it a spaceship?
No… It's a living creature! A giant one!
What!? A creature? Did you say a creature!?
That's impossible?
Kikiih!!
It's incredibly fast! It's about to enter the atmosphere!!
What is going on…
I can't believe it… Planet Gyeron has a temperature of 270 degrees and 0.6% oxygen. Nothing could possibly live in a place like that!
But there was a creature there! And the shock of Super Weapon R1's explosion mutated it.
It's my responsibility… I'm the one who chose Planet Gyeron as the test site!
All of us agreed to it too. It isn't your responsibility alone. Stop blaming yourself!!
Captain! We've mounted the new-type missile on Hawk 2.

Good…

It's the missile bomb Dr. Tsuchida at the Science Center has been researching! Let's test its power…

Amagi, Soga, Anne, intercept the star beast in Ultra Hawk 1! Cover Hawk 2!
Roger!!

Please wait!!

Let us sortie too! We'll draw Gyeron's attention until the new missile bomb is fired!
Mm… You'll do it? Chief Kitakura, I'm counting on you.
Fire the missile!!
Firing the missile!
Fire!!
Kieeeeh!
We got it!!

(…I should have stopped the R1 test, no matter what.

If I truly loved the Earth… I was the only one who could have done it, for the sake of defending the Earth…)
Hey, Dan! What's wrong? What are you brooding about?
Nothing…
We beat the enemy. Let's head back to base!
The enemy… was it?
Well, good work.
Captain, that was an anticlimactic end.

Mm…

But… something's strange about it…
Yes… It's the thing that survived even Super Weapon R1's explosion.
Hmm…
Maybe it used up its energy flying through space.
That's right! I'm sure that's it.
Mm… It's a relief that we kept the damage to a minimum…

Well, there's no telling what powerful invaders may come from now on. We have to finish R2 as soon as possible!

No, in theory, we could even build even more powerful super weapons… R3, R4. Chief of Staff Takenaka, we can't sit around like this.
Th-this is terrible!! Gyeron has appeared again!!

What!?

All right! Ultra Hawk 2 and 3, sortie! Dan, begin attacking from the ground in the Pointer!!

It seems it absorbed radioactive material from the R1 we fired…

At this rate, the whole surrounding area will suffer serious damage.
All of this is my responsibility!
That's right! It's us committee members who…
This is no time to be saying such things. I share the responsibility too…
Chief of Staff Takenaka. The only thing that can save us from this crisis is Super Weapon R2!
But… what if using R2 changes it into an even more powerful creature!?

Maeno! Even as things are, this whole area is in danger. I want to bet on R2's destructive power!!

I need time… If only R2 were finished!

Chief of Staff Takenaka… I just can't bring myself to hate that Gyeron.

The shock of R1's explosion turned it into that terrifying space kaiju, but it may really have been a peaceful creature living on the beautiful planet Gyeron.

And I…
I feel the same…

I was careless too… We needed to be far more careful.

Committee Member Segawa… a race to develop super weapons isn't the only way to defend the Earth.
Chief of Staff Takenaka… The radiation-contaminated area has been completely sealed off.
Are the officers all right?
Only Dan was exposed to a large dose of radiation, but he's been decontaminated and is resting in the Medical Center now.

I see…

Captain Kiriyama… Do you think that once Super Weapon R2 is complete, peace on Earth can be protected for certain?
Well… the invaders might attack Earth with even more powerful weapons of destruction.
Mm… And we'll build even more powerful weapons of destruction. To protect the Earth…

Come to think of it… Dan kept talking in his delirium.

Something about "a marathon we keep running while coughing up blood"…

Dan said that?

Chief of Staff… are human beings really such foolish creatures that they'd keep running a marathon like that?
Ah, Chief of Staff Takenaka! Dr. Maeno…
Ah… stay lying down. How are you feeling?

Well… I'm all right now.

…Um, Chief of Staff. I have a request…
All right, understood!
I haven't said anything yet!

No, you don't need to say it…

I'm about to attend the committee meeting, and I'll propose that the production of R2 be halted at once.

What!?

Chief of Staff Takenaka!!
Dan… I'll do what I can to persuade the other committee members too.
Please do!!
Yes…
Thank you so much!!
Well then… take care of yourself, okay?
Now, let's go…
Isn't that great, Dan…

U09189: そうだ! 我々委員の… unfinished; rendered "It's us committee members who…".
U09210: 握事 unclear; read as 提言/提案 ("propose").
